errors.description: voltage_code_q is a multi-bit value produced in volt_clk and sampled directly in pmu_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
droop_pulse_q is a one-cycle volt_clk pulse consumed directly in pmu_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
droop_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample pmu_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in pmu_event_o.
alarm_mode_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector alarm_mode_q before decoding in pmu_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
volt_rst_n is used as data inside pmu_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
sys_snapshot_q combines volt_clk payload state with pmu_clk status state in sys_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
